description_en: Migrates protected IP addresses from an Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 从DDoS防护包迁移防护对象IP
name: MoveIp

parameters.help_en:
The list of IP addresses to migrate to an Anti-DDoS Origin instance for protection. The list is represented as a character string in JSON array format. Each element in the JSON array is a structure that contains the following fields:

ip: String type. Required. The IP address to add.

member_uid: String type. Optional. The member accounts to which the asset belongs. This field is required only when you add an asset under member accounts. Example: [{"ip":"121.41.XX.XX","member_uid":"120100811162****"}]
parameters.help_zh:
要迁移到原生防护实例进行防护的IP地址列表。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：

ip：String类型  必选  要添加的IP地址。

member_uid：String类型  可选  资产所属的成员账号，仅当添加成员账号下的资产时需要输入本字段。例如：[{\"ip\":\"121.41.XX.XX\",\"member_uid\":\"120100811162****\"}]
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
目的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query all regions supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
原生防护实例的地域 ID

您可以调用 DescribeRegions 查询 DDoS 原生防护支持的所有地域信息
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances
parameters.help_zh:
源DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID
parameters.name: source_instance_id
